I need to add a booking section on the homepage. Where? The homepage has a hero with a booking button, then a contact-strip, services, about, steps (with a booking action) and a cta band (booking). A booking section fits best after the contact strip or services. The page already has a closing cta, so I'll place the booking section right after the services list, so it is visible without scrolling too far.

Rule: the contact facts should appear in one place only, and the contact-strip already includes the hours. So I use the simple variant, not with-hours, to avoid repeating the hours.

Text: no invented facts. "Delamo samo po predhodnem naročilu." is from the brief. The heading should be concrete: "Rezervirajte svoj termin". The action target is {"action":"booking"}, and the business has a bookingUrl.

Index: sections are hero(0), strip(1), services(2), about(3)... Insert at /pages/0/sections/3, which places it after services. The tone is left unset (default), and the neighbours are services (default) and about (alt), so it reads well.
